name: theme-picker
title: Theme Picker
description: Light, Dark and System as radio tiles, or with variant="compact" as a full-width row of icon-only radios for a sidebar or header, and useThemePreference(), which stores the choice and applies it: a class on <html> on the web, Appearance.setColorScheme on device, where the app passes its own storage. With palettes={PALETTE_PREFERENCES} it adds a palette choice beside the theme (default, or the dark-only monokai), stored by usePalettePreference() and applied as data-palette on <html> on the web and by PaletteProvider on device. THEME_PRE_PAINT_SCRIPT is the inline <script> that paints the stored theme and palette before React mounts.
